name: interrogate
purpose: Adversarially review changes through competing reviewers and pragmatic lead judgment without automatically applying changes.
inputs: Diff or files and surrounding context
Authorized reviewer selections and observed capabilities
outputs: Intent, Reviewers, Act On, Consider, Noted, Dismissed and Agreement Map
Attributed findings with evidence, category and lead rationale
Observed worker independence, model diversity and limits
ordinaryExample: Challenge a branch diff with identical reviewer prompts, then trace a disputed null-input finding to its caller before categorizing it.
capabilityLimits: Independent reviewers require observed authorized spawn and result inspection.
Unknown or identical observed models do not establish model diversity.
Missing source or denied review blocks grounded findings.
Invocation metadata is retained without claiming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
